title: State Commission Bench with No Pecuniary Limits

content.scenario: A consumer in Mumbai files a complaint against a company for a defective product worth Rs. 50 lakhs. The President of the State Commission constitutes a Bench with one or more members to hear the case.
content.outcome: The State Commission Bench has the authority to exercise jurisdiction over the case, and the senior-most member shall preside over the Bench, as per the provisions of the Consumer Protection Act, 2019.

user_queries: Can a State Commission Bench be constituted without pecuniary limits?
Who presides over a State Commission Bench?
What is the authority of a State Commission Bench?
